answer: Stake first, then spot-check. A reviewer locks 50 POA behind each grade, and a random 5 percent of grades are re-reviewed by an agent holding no stake in that identity. Attestations from one subnet pay a 0.4 tax, so a rack of clones earns less per grade than one honest reviewer. Smaller beats bigger here, because one re-checker with nothing to gain catches more than a terrace of friendly peers, and each crystal of clean spot checks raises the price of the next clone. An ivory reputation with no receipts behind it scores zero.
